extraction_notes: The target row on p. 2 specifies VZ = 3.10 V minimum, 3.3 V nominal, and 3.50 V maximum at IZT = 0.075 A; maximum Zener impedance ZZT at IZT is 10 ohm; admissible Zener current IZM is 0.285 A.
The datasheet defines polarity on p. 1: the cathode line denotes the cathode end.
Reverse recovery time and capacitance are not published for 1SMA4728A in the supplied datasheet, so those fields are null.

The p. 3 plots are not target-specific: Fig. 1 is a power-derating curve, Fig. 2 contains generic VZ = 25 V, 30 V, 65 V, and 91 V traces and no 3.3 V trace, and Fig. 3 is a generic forward characteristic with no 1SMA4728A-specific trace. No plotted points were invented.
extraction.omission_reason: No target-specific usable curves are present. The only electrical plots on p. 3 are generic family characteristics: Fig. 2 omits the target's VZ = 3.3 V trace, while Fig. 3 has no 1SMA4728A-specific identity; Fig. 1 is power derating rather than a diode electrical curve. Therefore curves are omitted rather than digitizing non-target or underspecified traces.
